sampling: Python Random(seed); fixed DOMAINS/QUESTION_TYPES; sorted groups shuffled per domain, assigned round-robin to disjoint family pools; one uniformly random sorted source QA per group; first 7 candidates and next 7 same-cell reserves
qualification: first seven qualified in each frozen ordered cell; at most 14 processed; no cross-cell borrowing; exhausted cell is a shortfall
analysis: descriptive balanced-design acceptance and empirical Fleiss kappa; fixed-prevalence score statistic retained only as labeled planning-model sensitivity, no achieved-power claim
